_about: Robinson Ellis (1834-1913), Corpus Professor of Latin at Oxford. Works with English commentary or prose; his verse Catullus is held on the catullus shelf (PG 18867). Latin-only editions (Noctes Manilianae, Appendix Vergiliana, Ibis) not taken. Round dx (2026-10-23) added, raw IA OCR with title pages read: The Fables of Avianus (Clarendon Press, 1887) and his Oxford lectures and papers: The New Fragments of Juvenal (1901), A New Edition of Manilius Book I (Hermathena, 1904), The Correspondence of Fronto and M. Aurelius (1904), On the Historia Augusta (Hermathena, 1905), The Elegiae in Maecenatem (1907), The Annalist Licinianus (1908). Not taken: his Latin-only recensions (Catullus, Ibis, Velleius, Appendix Vergiliana, Noctes Manilianae).

ellis-commentary-catullus-1889: A Commentary on Catullus (2nd ed., Oxford, 1889)
ellis-aetna-1901: Aetna: a critical recension of the text, with prolegomena, translation, commentary (Oxford, 1901)
